we propose six novel ensemble diversity metrics, coined as HQ metrics, that effectively identify and prune deep ensembles with low ensemble diversity, and significantly increase the lower bound of accuracy of the remaining deep ensembles, by introducing the concept of focal models and hierarchical pruning.
we introduce six HQ ensemble diversity metric and a hierarchical pruning method to select high diversity deep ensemble.

our hierarchical diversity pruning can select the best deep ensembles from a large pool of candidate deep ensembles, and can significantly increase the lower bound accuracy of the selected ensemble, compared to the existing diversity pruning methods.

the fundamental question of how to effectively measure the diversity of a deep ensemble and how to effectively prune those deep ensemble with insufficient diversity.
the problem of identifying and pruning deep ensembles that fail to deliver effective ensemble diversity, and thus failing to deliver high accuracy.
improving the accuracy and robustness for deep ensembles by selecting high diversity ensembles, which is a fundamental and challenging research problem.

our proposed hierarchical pruning approach can effectively identify and select high diversity ensembles by pruning low diversity ones, and thus increase the lower bound accuracy for the selected deep ensembling models.
the proposed hierarchical pruning method based on the proposed HQ-metrics can be a useful approach to effectively select high quality deep ensembles.

the HQ-metrics can be used to select deep ensembles that have a higher diversity than the ensembles selected using the Q-metrics, and that these ensembles can also achieve a higher lower bound accuracy than the ensembles that are selected using the Q-diversity metrics, and that this is true across all the datasets that we tested.

our hierarchical diversity pruning method is able to select deep ensembles with higher ensemble diversity, and thus higher accuracy and robustness, compared to those deep ensembles selected using state-of-the-art diversity metrics.
